feeds.title: RunningPhysio
feeds.description: The site offers advice to runners on injury treatment and prevention. Written by Tom Goom, a physiotherapist with over 15 years of experience and a very keen runner.

feeds.title: Women's Running
feeds.description: Women's Running focuses on women's running training advice for 5K, 10K, half marathons and marathons, female-specific kit reviews, and women's running shoe reviews. Women's Running Magazine is the UK's lifestyle magazine for women who run. The magazine has been going for more than 12 years, and in that time it has inspired thousands of women to enjoy running and to progress further than they ever thought possible.

feeds.title: The Runner Beans
feeds.description: Focuses on marathon training, running tips, recipes, nutrition advice, and kit reviews. Authored by Charlie Watson, a Registered Dietitian, author of Cook Eat Run, and thirteen-time marathoner.

feeds.title: Lazy Girl Running Blog
feeds.description: The blog ran by Laura Fountain who is a UK Athletics coach in running fitness, aims to provide practical running advice on run coaching, marathon running, injuries, and running gears.

feeds.title: UKRunChat
feeds.description: Welcome to the UK's online running community. Here they facilitate chat about all things running. Stay updated with the latest running news and check out the interviews with some of the best runners. You can also read the reviews of running gear and other helpful products.

feeds.title: RunUltra
feeds.description: This is the place to find out all there is to know about ultra running, ultra race listings and reviews from our runner community. The home of Ultra Runners. Find Ultra Marathon events, share tips & stories, read Ultra Running gear reviews & keep up with the latest Ultra Running news. Mission is to Inspire runners to do extraordinary events in amazing places.

feeds.title: parkrun UK Blog
feeds.description: Parkrun events take place in pleasant parkland surroundings and we encourage people of every ability to take part; from those taking their first steps in running to Olympians, from juniors to those with more experience, we welcome you all. Find weekly, 5k & 2k events. Walk, jog, run or volunteer!

feeds.title: Trina Runs
feeds.description: Trina Dawkins is a 40-year-old Londoner with a penchant for Running. She loves to run and enjoys writing especially documenting her runs whether they are good or bad. These reflections help her prepare for my next run. Follow along her journey of achieving fitness and well-being through tips and updates on her blog.

feeds.title: the5krunner - Triathlon, Duathlon, Training & Tech
feeds.description: The5krunner is authored by three 'mysterious' runners and triathletes. Using their expertise in multi-sports training and a deep interest in sports technology, the authors provide detailed posts with tips on the best devices, regimes and other accessories to help with speed, endurance and training fun.

feeds.title: RunThrough
feeds.description: RunThrough is a London based running community with running events, training sessions and coaching. We organise fun and affordable races over a variety of distances within London. We also have a growing community (online and offline) of passionate runners who meet on a regular basis for training & social events.

feeds.title: The PhD Runner
feeds.description: Emma Neachell is a running blogger based between London and Birmingham, England. She writes about running, fitness, food, and the trials and tribulations of life.

feeds.title: RUNR Blogs
feeds.description: Welcome to runr - the fitness and lifestyle brand for people passionate about running. We firmly believe that the best thing about running is the community and we hope by wearing runr products, you engage with other runners in everyday life and share stories of triumph and failure.

feeds.title: Vegan Runners
feeds.description: Vegan Runners UK is a friendly club made up of vegans from all over the UK (and beyond). Members range from beginners to highly experienced runners, from casual joggers to dedicated athletes.

feeds.title: Dreaming Of Footpaths
feeds.description: Sarah Booker's blog is a brutally honest, amusing insight into her running adventures, which first started when she realised she was the 'fat friend' and decided to do something about it.

feeds.title: pickupthepacepaul
feeds.description: Running, pacing and motivating others around me. Sharing my experiences of races and events I pace, which I do as often as I can. Hopefully jam packed with motivation and advice for anyone who reads.

feeds.title: FN Trail Running Cheshire
feeds.description: I am an trail & off-road running coach based in Stockport and on the Cheshire / Derbyshire border. I can help you improve your running; on, or off road. My site started out very much as a personal blogging space, covering my running as well as my other interests.

feeds.title: Maria Runs | Running, baking, tea, chocolate...
feeds.description: Maria blogs about her parkruns, marathons and half marathons in a personal diary-esque style to keep her readers up to date with her progress. When Maria isn't running, she enjoys baking brownies and cookies (not so much cupcakes), which was the inspiration for her blog name.

feeds.title: Lymm Runners
feeds.description: We are a friendly club with an aim to promote running for fun, fitness and competition in the Lymm area. So whether you are a beginner or an experienced runner we will always give you a warm welcome and offer you tons of encouragement.

feeds.title: Dallam Running Club
feeds.description: Go running with dallam in south cumbria and north lancashire.

feeds.title: Miss Wheezy
feeds.description: I'm Beki, a fitness enthusiast who loves running, yoga, cycling, getting sweaty, muddy and living life to the full! This blog is to document my progress, and look back at how far I've come it still amazes me sometimes. Mission is to inspire others on a journey of fitness, food and fun!

feeds.title: Men's Running magazine
feeds.description: The UK's first running magazine just for men. Regular training plans, features and gear reviews for runners of all abilities. Your guide to the latest news, top training tips, kit reviews and race previews. Whether you're a beginner or ultra aficionado, Men's Running is here to help. Men's Running is the only digital community dedicated for men who just love to run.

feeds.title: NI Running
feeds.description: NI Running aims to bring you great content on Northern Ireland Running. Club news, results, race reports, and race announcements for road, cross country, and ultras. A website dedicated to all things running in Northern Ireland! Road, Mountain, Track, Trail, and Cross Country. We endeavor to cover it all.

feeds.title: JogBlog
feeds.description: A light-hearted look at running, cycling and general fitness. JogBlog provides novice runners with a starting point to get them to make achievable running goals, while providing the tips, inspiration and advice that they need to push themselves.

feeds.title: Powderach Running
feeds.description: Rachel started her blog to hold herself to an ultra run around the Isle of Wight last year, and has kept writing after the race. She loves finding new trails and getting muddy—both things you can do not far out of the city!

feeds.title: Running Buggies
feeds.description: The only 'Mum run' UK specialist retailer in running (or off road) buggies. Let us help you decide which is the right running buggy for you by stocking the key buggies from multiple retailers & navigating your through the key facts and figures. Find Helpful articles, sometimes interviews and maybe even personal experiences written by us on all things buggy running related.

feeds.title: I Can Run Club
feeds.description: We are a women only running community. We provide beginners running sessions and free runs for women in Suffolk. We are ordinary but fabulous women keen to get others moving regardless of their age, size or ability. Our mission is to show women of all ages, sizes and backgrounds that they can run. We believe that all women have it in them to find what makes them feel epic.

feeds.title: National Running Show
feeds.description: We are the UK's biggest non-race affiliated running exhibition, providing all of the kit, advice, tech, and support needed to achieve your running goals.

feeds.title: VirtualRacingUK
feeds.description: Virtual racing uk runs virtual races, virtual runs, virtual cycle races, virtual triathlons and virtual fitness challenges.

feeds.title: Heights of Madness
feeds.description: Writing about running in the high places of Scotland.

feeds.title: RunYoung50
feeds.description: Run Young 50 is all about women runners over 50. Find out more about what motivates older women to run and the history of women's distance running.

feeds.title: The Ridgeway Runner
feeds.description: A journey in running. I'm a dad, a husband, an Operations Director and a newbie runner. This website is my dumping ground for stuff!

feeds.title: Running 101
feeds.description: Welcome to Running101, home of all things running, training advice, motivation, running and strength workouts, and so much more!

feeds.title: RUNNING DIFFERENT
feeds.description: Follow this blog to get articles and updates on running A to Z of Perthshire.

feeds.title: Northern Fells Running Club
feeds.description: We are a small friendly fell running club based in and around the Northern Fells of the Lake District National Park, formed in December 2014. We encourage members to take part in FRA races and have club championships to help encourage participation in local races.

feeds.title: Ultra Running Matelot
feeds.description: Blog about Ultra Marathon Running. I'm in my mid 30's, I took up running for a challenge and to lose some weight. Now just running isn't a challenge and I have to find bigger and harder challenges involving running each time.

feeds.title: Milly | Running
feeds.description: Milly Voice is a long distance runner, and brand ambassador for Salomon. This blog is a place for me to recommend kit, write about adventures, talk about racing, and things worth a line or two.

feeds.title: Iona Running Blog by Iona Mackay
feeds.description: You will read about Iona's life, her love of running and her desire to get better, faster and stronger and the trials and tribulations she will go through to get there.

feeds.title: Improve My Running
feeds.description: We are the first accredited running centre in Scotland of The Running School, London, We coach adults and children to run efficiently and injury-free. We are passionate about running,whether it is for health, lifestyle or racing at the highest level we are here to help you be the best that you can be.

feeds.title: Running Adventures Blog
feeds.description: Running Adventures is 'run' by ultra runner and adventure seeker; Matt Buck. I'm a qualified running coach and have been guiding people through challenge events for over 10 years, driven by my passion for anything involving the outdoors. As well as completing a number of ultra marathons and intense personal physical challenges, I've also led groups on treks and cycles all around the world.

feeds.title: Ordinary Runner
feeds.description: This is a blog for the Ordinary Runners. Those who run for the love of it. Or, because they once got a PB and now they can't stop trying to beat it. We'll never be at the front of a race, but we don't care. This blog is for all of us Ordinary Runners, so get involved.

feeds.title: 4:20 to 2:40 - Musings of a Running Geek
feeds.description: A collection of musings on all things running related. Based on a potentially excessive amount of research, this is mostly for my own record.

feeds.title: Mike Runs
feeds.description: Mike Runs is a blog run by Mike, a running dad of three. He shares his experiences of running, training, and racing, as well as tips and advice for other runners. Mike shares his thoughts and experiences of running races, from short parkruns to long-distance marathons.

feeds.title: Ultramarathon Central
feeds.description: Ultramarathon Central is an ultra and trail running blog for veterans to novices. A one stop place for honest information, reviews and write ups.

feeds.title: RulaRuns
feeds.description: An average runner, enjoying the journey.

feeds.title: Julia Bleasdale | Lauf mit!
feeds.description: Julia is a long-distance runner. She represented Great Britain in the 5000m / 10000m at the London 2012 Olympic Games, placing eighth in both.

feeds.title: Keith's Marathon Blog My ongoing running project
feeds.description: Mid (to high) 50's. Proud to be a part of London Marathon and Marathon Paris runner on behalf of CLIC_Sargent. Blog by Keith Pullen.

feeds.title: Carys Matthews | Bristol Web Editor, Writer and Digital Consultant Blog
feeds.description: Freelance journalist, specialising in travel and outdoor fitness. She runs a lot (ultras and marathons) and when not galavanting around the globe is exploring the trails of her home Richmond Park and Wimbledon Common.
